results.title: Montreal Masters: Jodar overcomes Musetti; Norrie beats De Minaur
results.description: Rafael Jodar beats Lorenzo Musetti again in Montreal to reach fourth round, while Cameron Norrie stuns third seed Alex de Minaur.

results.title: ‘I want to be someone people can look up to’ — Wausau East seniors chase more than a title
results.description: Wausau East head football coach Tyler Kramer is entering his fourth season leading the Lumberjacks, and the program’s senior class is matching his commitment — organizing their own player-only practices all summer to prepare for the year ahead. Kramer, a Wausau East alumnus, has sent 10 players to the college level in his first three seasons as head coach. He said watching those players move on is one of the most meaningful parts of the job.

results.title: Nigerias great feat at Glasgow 2026
results.description: Team Nigeria achieved great feat at the 2026 Commonwealth Games held in Glasgow, Scotland, the 23rd in the series. Nigeria came 7th in the overall medals table with 10 gold, seven silver and seven bronze. Altogether, Nigeria had 24 medals. It was also Africas most successful contingent and the only African nation in the top 10. We commend Team Nigeria for the impressive outing in Glasgow. results.title: Pirates Problems: Bucs, Ravens Looking for Playoff Return
